```{r}
data <- read.csv("data/students.csv")
summary(data)
```


```{r}
## imput tidyverse formule
library(tidyverse)
```
```{r}
data %>% ## add table 
  summarise_if(is.numeric, list( ##numeric
    mean = mean,
    sd = sd,
    median = median,
    quantile = quantile,
    min = min,
    max = max
  ), na.rm = TRUE) ## skip the missing values
```


```{r}
## the summary is different from one column to the next because the column with not the same type of character
```
```{r}
summary(data)
```



```{r}
library(tidyverse)

students <- read_csv("data/students.csv")

# Histogramme de la variable Weight with copilot 
hist(data$Weight,
     main = "weight histogram",
     xlab = "weight",
     col = "blue",
     border = "black")
```
```
```{r}
```{r}
# Densité de la variable Weight with chatgpt 
ggplot(students, aes(x = Weight)) +
  geom_density(fill = "lightgreen", alpha = 0.5) +
  labs(title = "Density plot of Weight", x = "Weight (kg)", y = "Density")
```
```
```{r}
```{r}
# Boxplot de la variable Weight with chatgpt 
ggplot(students, aes(y = Weight)) +
  geom_boxplot(fill = "orange", color = "black") +
  labs(title = "Boxplot of Weight", y = "Weight (kg)")
```
